summary: The extensions directory holds content and metadata that extend a collection beyond plugins and roles, grouped by capability, such as extensions/audit/event_query.yml for resource reporting.
questions: What is the extensions directory in a collection for?

answer_card.title: The extensions directory
answer_card.answer_md: `extensions/` holds extra capability metadata, one subdirectory per capability. For example, `extensions/audit/event_query.yml` defines resource reporting queries.
